data: At approximately what training percentage does the F-Measure first reach 1.0?

The question asks for the approximate training percentage at which the F-Measure first reaches 1.0. From the caption, we know that the TPC (Training Percentage Cutoff) is set to 10%. The figure shows the learning curve for an SVM model trained with active learning and closest-to-hyperplane sampling on the TREC dataset. The F-Measure is plotted against the Training Percent. 

Looking at the figure, the F-Measure starts at 0 and increases rapidly until it reaches 1.0 around the 5% mark. After this point, the F-Measure remains constant at 1.0. Therefore, the F-Measure first reaches 1.0 at approximately 5%.
